lessons.title: Simple quiz
lessons.starter:
scene "classroom"
Teacher appears
ask "What is 2 + 2?"
choice "3" wrong
choice "4" correct
choice "5" wrong
if answer is correct
    Teacher says "Correct!"
end

lessons.title: Wrong answer
lessons.starter:
scene "school"
ask "Sky colour?"
choice "blue" correct
choice "red" wrong
if answer is correct
    Rafi says "Yes!"
else
    Rafi says "Try again!"
end

lessons.title: Score + quiz
lessons.starter:
scene "school"
score starts at 0
ask "1+1?"
choice "2" correct
choice "3" wrong
if answer is correct
    add 10 points
    Rafi says "Great!"
end

lessons.title: Choose path
lessons.starter:
scene "school"
Rafi appears
choose "Forest" or "School"
if choice equals "Forest"
    scene "jungle"
    Rafi says "Adventure!"
else
    Rafi says "Safe at school!"
end

lessons.title: Repeat 3 times
lessons.starter:
scene "school"
Rafi appears
repeat 3 times
    Rafi waves
end

lessons.title: Repeat with says
lessons.starter:
scene "playground"
Mina appears
repeat 2 times
    Mina says "Hello again!"
    wait 1 second
end

lessons.title: Counter variable
lessons.starter:
scene "school"
set n to 0
repeat while n is less than 3
    set n to n plus 1
    narrator says n
end

lessons.title: List loop
lessons.starter:
scene "school"
set fruits to list "apple" and "banana"
for each fruit in fruits
    narrator says fruit
end

lessons.title: Function greet
lessons.starter:
scene "school"
define greet
    Rafi says "Welcome!"
end
call greet
call greet

lessons.title: First game top
lessons.starter:
game "Coin Walk"
game view top
scene "school" with walls
Rafi is player
spawn coin at x 200 y 150

lessons.title: Game movement
lessons.starter:
game "Move"
game view top
scene "school" with walls
Mina is player
every frame
    if right key is held
        move Mina right by 5
    end
end

lessons.title: Collect coins
lessons.starter:
game "Collector"
game view top
scene "school" with walls
score starts at 0
Rafi is player
spawn coin at x 150 y 100
every frame
    if right key is held
        move Rafi right by 5
    end
end
if Rafi touches coin
    add 10 points
    remove coin
end
